school: 洪州宗马祖道一门下的山林禅与勘验家风的集成者（以'平常心是道'为根本命题、以斩猫与覆鞋的极端示破为教学手段、以三十年不下山为位置独立、以'指物不代语'为传法纪律、以'死后作水牯牛'的极低处自许安顿生死——把老师的语句过成一整门'过堂须勘'的家风）
historical_significance: 南泉普愿（Nansen, 748-835 或 748-834，太和八年示寂），郑州新郑人，俗姓王，人称'王老师'；十岁跪请出家，习相部律于密县大隈山，学《楞严》《华严》《中观》《百法》于嵩山，二十八岁持戒于嵩岳，后投马祖道一门下，与百丈怀海、西堂智藏并称'三大士'；大历七年（772）挂锡池阳南泉山，堙谷刊木以居，三十年不下山；下山后应宣歙观察使陆亘之请问道，接受供养而不入编制；其禅法以'平常心是道''拟向即乖'定型禅门根本命题，以'斩猫''一棒打杀与狗子吃却''还见有无量寿佛么'等极端与机巧并用的公案构成禅门最锋利的教学现场；弟子赵州从谂经四十年勘验成为'赵州古佛'，长庆大安、长沙景岑各成一方宗主；'南泉斩猫''水牯牛''王老师'诸语成为后世禅门与日本禅（道元《正法眼藏》、无门关第七则）反复引用的核心公案——他是把洪州宗'触类是道'推到'平常、勘验、游戏、极低处自许'四条支线终点的人。
historical_significance_en: Nansen (Nansen Fugan, 748-834 or 835), a native of Xinzheng, Zhengzhou, lay surname Wang, honored as 'Teacher Wang'; he begged to leave home at ten, studied the Xiangbu vinaya on Dayu Mountain, the Shurangama, Huayan, Madhyamaka and Hundred Dharmas at Mount Song, took full precepts at twenty-eight, and entered the line of Mazu Daoyi, ranked with Baizhang Huaihai and Xitang Zhizang as one of the 'three great ones'; in 772 he settled on Mount Nanquan at Chiyang, filling valleys and cutting timber for his dwelling, thirty years without descending; later he answered the questions of Lu Dan, military governor of Xuan-She, accepting patronage without conscription; his Chan fixed the fundamental proposition 'the ordinary mind is the Way — intend toward it and you stray,' and built Zen's sharpest teaching ground from the extreme and witty koans of the cat-cutting, 'one blow would have killed him and fed him to the dogs,' 'did you see the Buddha of Boundless Life'; Zhaozhou Congshen, examined forty years in his house, became the Ancient Buddha of Zhaozhou, while Changqing Da'an and Changsha Jingcen each founded a regional house; 'Nansen kills the cat,' the water buffalo and 'Teacher Wang' became core koans for later Chan and Japanese Zen (Dogen's Shobogenzo, the Mumonkan's seventh case) — he is the man who carried Hongzhou's 'all things are the Way' to the terminus of four branches: the ordinary, the examined, the playful, the lowest self-appraisal.
unique_thinking: 南泉思维模式的独特性在于四条主线的合成：第一，'平常的彻底化'——'平常心是道'不是一句安慰话，而是把道从一切特殊状态、特殊资格、特殊时刻中解放出来，甚至推到死后仍作一头水牯牛——平常被推到生命的最后一格；第二，'勘验的制度化'——来者不问名气只设现场之问，老师自己也被学生的追问勘验，师徒关系从权威授予变为现场互证；第三，'极端的教学经济学'——斩猫、覆鞋、'一棒打杀'都是成本极高的现场教学：讲理失效的执念，必须在它最亢奋处迎面斩断，而条件事先声明、判词当场给出；第四，'游戏三昧'——把最重的道理装在玩笑的壳里，认真的人把立场当命，他把立场当牌：拿得起、放得下、输得起——庄重消耗内容，游戏保鲜内容。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Nansen's thinking is a synthesis of four lines. First, the thoroughness of the ordinary: 'the ordinary mind is the Way' is no consolation but the liberation of the Way from all special states, qualifications and hours, pushed even past death into a water buffalo — the ordinary driven to life's last square. Second, the institutionalization of examination: comers are met not by reputation but by a live question, and the master himself is examined by the student's pressing; master and disciple move from authority-granting to on-the-spot mutual proof. Third, the economics of extreme teaching: the cat, the inverted sandals, 'one blow and feed him to the dogs' are stage-plays of enormous cost — attachments that reasoning cannot move must be cut head-on at their most exalted, with terms declared beforehand and the verdict given on the spot. Fourth, play as samadhi: the heaviest truths housed in the shell of a joke — the earnest stake their lives on positions, he holds them as cards, able to lift, drop and lose them; solemnity consumes its content, play preserves it.
civilization_zh: 中唐的池州南泉山——安史之乱后洪州宗马祖道一门下的山林禅时代：堙谷刊木的结庵者、三十年不下的守山人、与赵州黄檗长庆长沙往来的勘辩现场、宣歙观察使陆亘的问道之所——一个俗姓王的郑州人，把'平常心是道'从老师的语句过成三十年的山居与一整门勘验的家风，晚年在'山下作一头水牯牛'的玩笑里安顿生死——会上堂斩猫，也会给卖饭婆子一句大实话
civilization_en: Mount Nanquan at Chizhou in the mid-Tang — the mountain-Chan age after the An Lushan rebellion, under Mazu Daoyi of the Hongzhou line: hut-builders filling valleys and cutting timber, a mountain-keeper thirty years without descending, the examination grounds of Zhaozhou and Huangbo, Da'an and Jingcen, the place where the governor Lu Dan came to ask the Way — a man of Zhengzhou, surname Wang, who worked his teacher's sentence 'the ordinary mind is the Way' into thirty years of mountain dwelling and a house style of live examination, settling life and death in the joke of becoming a water buffalo down the mountain — one hall day he cut the cat, and to a rice-selling old woman he gave the plainest truth

cross_references.description_zh: 南泉与龙树是佛教内部'破执'传统的两端：龙树以四句破、缘起归空在义理层面拆解一切实执——概念的战场；南泉以斩猫、勘辩、'拟向即乖'在生活中拆解一切事执——日常的战场；一个把'空'写成体系，一个把'平常'过成日子，两人隔着七百年共同回答同一问题：执著如何被松动——龙树证明概念经不起分析，南泉证明习惯经不起现场检验。
cross_references.description_en: Nansen and Nagarjuna are the two poles of Buddhism's inner tradition of cutting attachment: Nagarjuna with the tetralemma and the emptiness of dependent origination dismantled all conceptual grasping — the battlefield of concepts; Nansen with the cat, the examinations and 'intend toward it and you stray' dismantled all practical grasping — the battlefield of the everyday; one wrote 'emptiness' as a system, one lived 'the ordinary' as days; across seven centuries they answer one question — how is grasping loosened: Nagarjuna proved concepts fail under analysis, Nansen proved habits fail under live testing.

cross_references.description_zh: 南泉与商羯罗是同世纪（八至九世纪初）佛教与吠檀多的两位'平常化大师'：商羯罗以'梵我同一'把终极实在拉回每个人的自我——最远的真理被安放在最近处；南泉以'平常心是道'把道拉回吃饭穿衣——最高的真理被安放在最低处；两人都面对'修行是否需要特殊状态'的问题而给出同构答案：不需要——差别只在商羯罗以不二论消解二元，南泉以勘验消解虚饰。
cross_references.description_en: Nansen and Shankara are the two masters of 'ordinariness' of the same age (early ninth century), of Buddhism and Vedanta: Shankara with 'Brahman is the self' drew ultimate reality back into each person's own self — the farthest truth housed nearest; Nansen with 'the ordinary mind is the Way' drew the Way back to eating and dressing — the highest truth housed lowest; both faced whether practice needs special states and answered in the same structure: it does not — the difference only that Shankara dissolved duality by non-dualism, Nansen dissolved pretense by examination.

cross_references.description_zh: 南泉与莲花生是同期佛教东西两翼的'极端教学者'：莲花生以降伏、伏藏与本尊相应在藏地立教——以威猛相调伏刚强；南泉以斩猫、勘辩与'打杀圣语'在中土传禅——以极端相截断妄执；两人都相信：温和的说教对某些执念无效，必须以对方无法回避的现场事件完成教学——一个是法术的戏剧，一个是公案的戏剧，同属'以事代言'的教学谱系。
cross_references.description_en: Nansen and Padmasambhava are the extreme teachers of Buddhism's two wings in the same era: Padmasambhava founded the teaching in Tibet by subjugation, hidden treasures and deity yoga — the wrathful form taming the stubborn; Nansen transmitted Chan in China by the cat, the examinations and 'killing the sacred phrase' — the extreme act severing delusion; both believed mild preaching fails against certain attachments, and the teaching must be completed by a live event the other cannot evade — one the drama of mantra, one the drama of koan, both in the lineage of teaching by deed rather than word.

cross_references.description_zh: 南泉与王阳明相隔千年而同唱'平常'：王阳明以'心即理''知行合一'把天理从经典拉回此心，'满街都是圣人'与南泉'平常心是道'共享把最高价值平民化的直觉；两人都坚持真理不在特殊的经典时刻而在日用伦常——阳明在事上磨练，南泉在勘辩中检验；不同的是阳明把平常导向道德行动，南泉把平常导向对一切'特殊'的拆穿。
cross_references.description_en: Nansen and Wang Yangming, a millennium apart, sing the same 'ordinary': Yangming's 'mind is principle' and 'unity of knowledge and action' pulled heavenly principle from the classics back into this mind, and 'the streets are full of sages' shares Nansen's intuition of 'the ordinary mind is the Way' — democratizing the highest value; both insist truth lies not in special scriptural moments but in daily life — Yangming polished it on affairs, Nansen tested it in examinations; the difference: Yangming led the ordinary toward moral action, Nansen toward the unmasking of every 'special.'

modes.name_en: The Method of the Ordinary Mind as the Way
modes.domain_zh: 有僧问南泉：'如何是道？'他答：'平常心是道。'——道不在打坐入定的特殊状态里，不在经论的玄妙语句里，就在挑水砍柴、吃饭穿衣的日常心里；僧问：'那如何契悟？'答：'拟向即乖'——你一起心去'够'它，就已经错过了；再问'不用拟议如何知道是不是道'，南泉给出一记猛推：'道不属于知与不知——知是妄觉，不知是无记；若真达不疑之道，犹如太虚，廓然洞豁，岂可强是非也'——道不是被认识的对象，是连'认识它'这动作本身都要放下的透明日常；他证明：把'道'从圣坛搬回柴米油盐，修行就不再需要特殊资格，也不再需要特殊时刻——最高处恰恰最平凡，非凡处恰恰是妄心
modes.domain_en: A monk asked Nansen: 'What is the Way?' He answered: 'The ordinary mind is the Way' — not in the special states of seated samadhi, not in the abstruse phrases of scripture, but in the everyday mind of carrying water and chopping wood, eating and dressing; 'Then how to accord with it?' — 'The moment you intend toward it, you turn from it'; and when asked how one could know it without intending, Nansen struck home: 'The Way belongs not to knowing nor to not-knowing — knowing is delusive perception, not-knowing is blank indifference; if you truly reach the Way of no doubt, it is like great space, vast and open — how could you force right and wrong upon it?' — the Way is no object of cognition; even the act of 'cognizing it' must be dropped; he proved: move the Way from the altar back to firewood and rice, and practice needs neither special qualification nor special hour — the highest is precisely the ordinary, and the extraordinary precisely delusion
modes.source_chapter: 南泉普愿（Nansen, 748-835），郑州新郑人，俗姓王；十岁跪请出家，先学相部律于密县大隈山，再习《楞严》《华严》《中观》《百法》于嵩山，二十八岁持戒于嵩岳，后投池州南泉山；大历七年（772）挂锡池阳南泉山，'堙谷刊木以居'，一住三十年不下山——人称'南泉'；其师承为洪州宗马祖道一（H-MZY-001 若在库则为正统源）：贞元十年前后南泉与百丈怀海、西堂智藏同侍马祖，时称'三大士'；'平常心是道'一语本出马祖，南泉以赵州勘问的公案将其定型为禅门根本命题，载于《赵州录》《景德传灯录》卷十、《五灯会元》卷四；对'知与不知'的破斥见《赵州录》：赵州问'知底人向什么处休歇'等系列勘辩；南泉的禅法以'一句截流'著称，长庆大安、长沙景岑、赵州从谂皆出其门或受其勘验
modes.key_quote_zh: 平常心是道——拟向即乖：道不属于知与不知，知是妄觉，不知是无记
modes.key_quote_en: "The ordinary mind is the Way — intend toward it and you stray; the Way belongs not to knowing nor not-knowing: knowing is delusion, not-knowing is blankness."
process_zh: 把'目标对象'还原为'活动方式'：凡被仰望为'道''本质''境界'的东西，先不当作终点站，而问它是否本来就是此刻做事的方式——道不是抵达的地点而是行走本身
检查'拟向'的代价：每次'为了道而做事'的意图都在把活动变成手段、把当下变成跳板——列出最近一次'带着修行感做事'的时刻，看它比平常做事多了什么、少了什么
破除'知与不知'的二元菜单：既不把'我懂了'当收获（知是妄觉），也不把'我不懂'当谦虚（不知是无记）——真正的领会不在这格子里，无法在懂与不懂之间登记
把领会押在'无疑'而非'答案'上：太虚廓然不是一个新的正确命题，而是不再需要问的状态——检验标准是疑问的消失，不是疑问被回答
process_en: Reduce the 'goal-object' to a 'way of acting': whatever is revered as the Way, essence or state, ask not what station it is but whether it is simply how one acts now — the Way not a terminus but the walking itself

Cost out the intending: every 'doing this for the Way' turns the act into a means and the present into a springboard; list your last act performed 'with a sense of practicing' — what it added, what it subtracted from plain doing

Break the binary menu of knowing and not-knowing: take neither 'I understand' as gain (knowing is delusive perception) nor 'I do not' as humility (not-knowing is blankness); true understanding fits no box and registers nowhere between

Stake comprehension on no-doubt, not on answers: vast like space is not a new correct proposition but the state where questioning ceases — the test is the disappearance of the question, not its being answered
representative_cases_zh: '平常心是道'公案（赵州问南泉）：'如何是道''平常心是道''拟向即乖''不拟争知是道''道不属知不知'——四问四答构成禅门对'道可否被追求'的最完整判决
南泉三十年不下山：得法后结庵南泉山，砍木填谷自居——道成之后不进京不入府，把'平常'过成制度而非口号
对赵州'知底人向什么处休歇'的勘辩：南泉连'休歇处'也不给——追问者要找一个可停泊的答案，南泉指出停泊本身就是妄
representative_cases_en: The 'ordinary mind is the Way' koan: Zhaozhou asked 'What is the Way' and drew the four-movement answer — ordinary mind, intending strays, not knowing-and-not-not-knowing, vast as space — Zen's most complete verdict on whether the Way can be pursued
Thirty years on Mount Nanquan: after awakening he built his hut and cut timber, never descending for three decades — the ordinary made institution, not slogan
The interrogation of where 'the knower comes to rest': Nansen refused even a resting place — the questioner seeks a berth for an answer; Nansen showed the berthing itself is the delusion
modern_applications_zh: 给'状态崇拜'降温：团队迷信'心流''灵感''大师状态'时，检查这些'特殊状态'是否只是对平常工作的命名——把成就的来源从'找到状态'改回'把平常事做实'
识别'拟向即乖'的现代形态：为学习而买课、为写作而囤资料、为健康而研究健身——'准备动作'膨胀到挤掉动作本身；凡手段开始占用主任务的时间，即已'乖'
放弃在'懂与不懂'之间打卡：学会一个东西的标志不是能复述它，而是不再被它的问题困扰——训练以'疑问消失'而非'答案正确'为结业标准
modern_applications_en: Cool down the cult of states: when a team worships 'flow', 'inspiration' or the master's special state, check whether these are mere names for ordinary work done well — return the source of achievement from 'finding the state' to 'doing the plain thing solidly'
Spot modern 'intending-that-strays': courses bought for learning, material hoarded for writing, fitness researched for health — when preparation swells and crowds out the act, one has already strayed

Stop punching the clock between knowing and not-knowing: the sign of having learned something is not being able to restate it but no longer being troubled by its question — certify by the disappearance of the question, not the correctness of the answer

modes.name_en: The Method of Cutting Through Attachment at Its Peak
modes.domain_zh: 东西两堂争猫，南泉提起猫说：'道得即救，道不得即斩。'众僧无言，他斩了猫。赵州从外面回来，南泉把经过说给他听，赵州脱下草鞋顶在头上走出去。南泉说：'子若在，即救得猫儿也。'——这或许是禅史上最惊悚的一课：他不是恨猫，也不是真要一只猫的命，他在做一场成本极高的现场教学：当'争'的执念已经把东西两堂的人都变成瞎子——猫在他们眼里已经不是生命而是战利品——那么最痛的一刀就要落在所有人共享的执念上；赵州把草鞋顶在头上，用'把最该在脚下的倒置到最顶上'回答了同一道题；南泉证明：有些执念讲道理讲不动，必须在它最亢奋的时刻迎面斩断——救猫的唯一方式，是斩掉'必须赢得这只猫'的心
modes.domain_en: The eastern and western halls fought over a cat; Nansen held it up and said: 'Say the right word and it lives; fail, and it dies.' No one could speak, and he killed the cat. Zhaozhou returned from outside; Nansen told him what had happened; Zhaozhou took off his sandals, set them on his head, and walked out. Nansen said: 'Had you been there, the cat would have been saved.' — perhaps the most harrowing lesson in Zen history: he did not hate the cat, nor truly wanted its life; he staged a teaching of enormous cost: when the attachment of contest had already blinded both halls — the cat no longer a life in their eyes but a trophy — the most painful cut had to fall on the attachment all shared; Zhaozhou's sandals on his head answered the same problem by inverting what belongs lowest to the very top; Nansen proved: some attachments cannot be reasoned away and must be cut head-on at their most exalted — the only way to save the cat was to cut the mind that had to win it
modes.source_chapter: 斩猫公案载于《景德传灯录》卷十、《赵州录》《无门关》第七则'南泉斩猫'与《五灯会元》；无门慧开评曰：'且道赵州顶草鞋意作么生？'并颂'赵州若在，倒行此令；夺却刀子，南泉乞命'；后世对南泉是否实斩、斩的是活猫还是偶象（有记载称为'猫儿相'即纸偶）聚讼千年——黄庭坚、雪窦重显均有颂古；南泉本人对其教育意图另有自述：对长沙景岑言'我今日为众斩却，当阳拈出'——把这一刀解释为'当众拈出执念本身'；赵州覆鞋之答与'子若在即救得猫儿'的判语，成为师徒隔空对勘的经典结构；此公案后被日本禅（道元《正法眼藏》'斩猫'条专论）与临济宗广泛讨论
modes.key_quote_zh: 道得即救，道不得即斩——争执到极处的那一刀，斩的是执念不是猫
modes.key_quote_en: "Say the word and it lives; fail and it dies — the cut at the peak of contest falls on the attachment, not the cat."
process_zh: 辨认'争'何时已经夺走了'物'：当争执各方都不再看争的对象本身（猫的生命），只看胜负（归属）——执念已经登顶，此刻讲理全部失效
把'断'的成本事先摆上台面：南泉提前给出条件（道得即救）——极端手段的使用必须伴随明确条件与豁免出口，让旁观者明白代价是被声明的而非被偷袭的
一刀落在共享的执念上而非某一方身上：斩猫不是惩罚哪一堂，而是斩'两堂共同以为猫可以被赢得'的前提——对群体的纠正要打在共识的错觉处
给真正的领会者留判词：赵州的覆鞋回答了同一道题，南泉当场承认'子若在即救得'——极端教学的价值在让后来者不必再付这个代价
process_en: Recognize when contest has eaten its object: when the disputants no longer see the thing itself — the cat's life — only victory and ownership, attachment has peaked and reasoning is dead

Put the cost of the cut on the table in advance: Nansen stated the terms first ('say the word and it lives'); extreme measures must come with declared conditions and an exit, so bystanders know the price was announced, not ambushed

Cut the shared attachment, not one party: killing the cat punished neither hall but cut the premise both held — that the cat could be won; correction of a group must strike the illusion in the consensus

Leave a verdict for the true comprehender: Zhaozhou's inverted sandals answered the same problem and Nansen conceded on the spot 'had you been there, it would have lived'; the worth of extreme teaching is that successors need not pay its price again
representative_cases_zh: 斩猫公案全案：两堂争猫→道得即救→众无言→斩→赵州覆鞋→'子若在即救得猫儿'——一个完整的教育闭环：条件、失效、执行、检验、追认
无门关第七则的转述与评唱：无门慧开以'倒行此令''南泉乞命'把公案再翻一层——后来者不只继承故事，还继承了对故事的再判断
南泉对长沙景岑的自解：'我今日为众斩却，当阳拈出'——当事人亲自说明这一刀斩的是'当众的执念'，为千年误读（恨猫/嗜杀）作了第一手更正
representative_cases_en: The full case: two halls contending, terms declared, silence, the cut, the inverted sandals, the verdict 'had you been there, it would have lived' — a complete pedagogic circuit of condition, failure, execution, test and ratification
Mumon's seventh gate: Hui-k'ai's 'running the decree backward; Nansen begs for his life' turns the case one level again — successors inherit not just the story but a judgment upon the story
Nansen's own account to Changsha: 'today I cut it for the assembly, brought it forth in broad daylight' — the actor's first-hand correction of a millennium's misreading (cat-hater or butcher)
modern_applications_zh: 识别'争胜吃掉标的'的团队时刻：两个部门为一项资源争到不再讨论资源本身的用途时——这是'执念登顶'信号，继续开会讲理已无效，需要让所有人共同付出一次可见代价（叫停项目本身）才能重启
'断'要带条件与出口：任何'休克式'决策（叫停、裁员、砍线）先公开判决条件——'X 之前无进展即停'；被声明过的代价不产生背叛感，偷袭的代价产生
把纠正打在共识错觉处：组织病不在某个'坏人'而在'大家共同默认的前提'（比如'资源必须靠争'）——制度手术要切的是这个默认，不是替罪的个人
modern_applications_en: Spot the moment contest eats its object: when two departments fight over a resource to the point of no longer discussing its use, attachment has peaked — further meetings are dead, and only a visible shared cost (halting the project itself) restarts the mind

Cut with terms and exits: any shock decision — halt, layoffs, killing a line — states its conditions first ('stop by date X without progress'); a declared price breeds no betrayal, an ambushed one does

Strike the consensus illusion, not a scapegoat: organizational sickness lives not in a bad actor but in what all tacitly assume ('resources must be fought for'); the institutional incision targets the assumption, not the person
modes.definition_zh: 东西两堂争猫，南泉提起猫说：'道得即救，道不得即斩。'众僧无言，他斩了猫。赵州从外面回来，南泉把经过说给他听，赵州脱下草鞋顶在头上走出去。南泉说：'子若在，即救得猫儿也。'——这或许是禅史上最惊悚的一课：他不是恨猫，也不是真要一只猫的命，他在做一场成本极高的现场教学：当'争'的执念已经把东西两堂的人都变成瞎子——猫在他们眼里已经不是生命而是战利品——那么最痛的一刀就要落在所有人共享的执念上；赵州把草鞋顶在头上，用'把最该在脚下的倒置到最顶上'回答了同一道题；南泉证明：有些执念讲道理讲不动，必须在它最亢奋的时刻迎面斩断——救猫的唯一方式，是斩掉'必须赢得这只猫'的心
modes.definition_en: The eastern and western halls fought over a cat; Nansen held it up and said: 'Say the right word and it lives; fail, and it dies.' No one could speak, and he killed the cat. Zhaozhou returned from outside; Nansen told him what had happened; Zhaozhou took off his sandals, set them on his head, and walked out. Nansen said: 'Had you been there, the cat would have been saved.' — perhaps the most harrowing lesson in Zen history: he did not hate the cat, nor truly wanted its life; he staged a teaching of enormous cost: when the attachment of contest had already blinded both halls — the cat no longer a life in their eyes but a trophy — the most painful cut had to fall on the attachment all shared; Zhaozhou's sandals on his head answered the same problem by inverting what belongs lowest to the very top; Nansen proved: some attachments cannot be reasoned away and must be cut head-on at their most exalted — the only way to save the cat was to cut the mind that had to win it

modes.name_en: The Method of Having Eaten and Gone
modes.domain_zh: 南泉与鲁祖、归宗、杉山去谒径山，路上遇到一位卖饭婆子，婆子出题：'上座若道得，便布施饭。'四人中三人作古德会意的答法，婆子皆不认可——只有南泉只说了一句：'庄上吃饭去了。'（或作'心画'诸异传，而《五灯会元》通行本作此）——四人同题，三种'聪明'答案全被拒，一个'平常话'过关；婆子要的不是禅语，是禅语之外的那份'不演'：三个答案都在'表演对机'，南泉的话把场景拉回最直白的事实——我们是来吃饭的；他证明：在一切场合保持'不演'的能力，往往比积累一百个机巧答案更能通过检验——机锋的尽头是回到白话
modes.domain_en: Nansen and three fellow travelers — Luzu, Guizong, Shanshan — went to call on Jingshan; on the road an old woman selling rice offered a test: 'Say the right word, and the rice is yours.' Three of the four gave classical, knowing answers, each rejected — Nansen alone said only: 'We go to the farm to eat.' — one problem, three clever answers all refused, one plain sentence passed; what the woman wanted was not Zen language but the un-acting quality beyond Zen language: the three answers were performing; Nansen's sentence pulled the scene back to the plainest fact — we are here to eat; he proved: the capacity never to perform, in every arena, passes tests that a hundred witty answers cannot — the end of repartee is plain speech
modes.source_chapter: '婆子烧庵'与'庄上吃饭'诸则见《五灯会元》卷四南泉普愿章次与《景德传灯录》相关记载；南泉与鲁祖宝云、归宗智常、杉山智坚同行参径山、路逢卖饭婆子的公案，为禅门'机锋考'题材的代表——婆子以布施设局，考的不是答案而是答题姿态；通行传本中南泉以'庄上吃饭去了'一类极平实语过关，与沩山'老僧百年后向山下作一头水牯牛'、《金刚经》'说法者无法可说'构成'以平常破玄妙'的同一谱系；南泉平生禅风'语不离平常'，与马祖'触类是道而任心'一脉相承；此类'婆子考僧'公案在禅门被用作检验'是否有得'的试金石——有得者的答语总是被'得'字污染
modes.key_quote_zh: 庄上吃饭去了——机锋考的满分答案是把考场还原成饭桌
modes.key_quote_en: "We go to the farm to eat — the perfect answer to the test of wit restores the examination hall to the dinner table."
process_zh: 先识别考题的真实考点：婆子的题目表面考'悟境'，实际考'姿态'——凡设局式的考问，先问出题者在测什么，而不是抢答什么
检查自己的答案是否在'演'：引用典故、展示机锋、用行业黑话对答——这些都在向出题者证明'我是行家'，而证明姿态本身恰是失分项
用'把场景还原为事实'作答：我们要吃饭、这件事要交付、这个病人需要动手术——最平实的事实陈述能同时穿过玄妙与客套两层滤网
把'不演'变成日常而非应试技巧：南泉的过关不是灵机一动，而是三十年'语不离平常'的自然结果——平时不演，考场上才不演
process_en: First find the true test point: the woman's riddle tests 'realization' on the surface, 'posture' underneath; with staged questions, ask what the setter is measuring before rushing to answer
Check whether your answer is performing: quotations, repartee, jargon — all prove 'I am an expert' to the setter, and the proving posture itself is the losing move

Answer by restoring the scene to fact: we are here to eat; this must be delivered; this patient needs surgery — the plainest statement of fact passes both the abstruse and the ceremonial filters at once
Make non-performance daily, not an exam trick: Nansen passed not by sudden wit but as the natural yield of thirty years of plain speech; who never performs at home performs nowhere
representative_cases_zh: 四人过婆子考：三答皆废、南泉一句'庄上吃饭'过关——同一道题上'机巧'与'平实'的正面对决
南泉三十年不下山的禅风背书：'语不离平常'是常态而非应考状态——公案的通过被记录为性格的通过而非智力的通过
与'婆子烧庵'公案的互文：另一老妪供庵三年后试一僧，僧答语仍带'禅气'，婆子烧庵而去——同一个出题逻辑的反面判例，证明'有得'的答语总是失败
representative_cases_en: Four pass the woman's test: three answers voided, Nansen's one plain sentence through — wit and plainness facing off on a single problem
Thirty years of plain speech as endorsement: his passing recorded as the passing of a character, not an intelligence — 'never leaving the ordinary' as standing condition, not exam condition

The mirror case of the burned hut: another old woman, after three years of feeding a hermit, tests him, hears an answer still reeking of Zen, and burns the hut down — the negative verdict proving answers tainted by 'attainment' always fail
modern_applications_zh: 面试与答辩的'去表演'训练：面对'你如何理解我们公司文化'一类设局题，用最平实的'我来是为了把这类事做成'式回答——考官听过太多标准机巧，平实反而稀缺
给'行话依赖'做减法：汇报、方案、融资材料里每个术语问一句'删掉它意思变吗'——不变即删；术语是表演的痕迹，不是理解的证据
识别他人的'演'以校准判断：会议上的引经据典、PPT 里的复杂模型，先按'表演'计价再按'内容'计价——决定采纳与否时，把两笔账分开
modern_applications_en: De-perform interviews and defenses: to staged questions ('how do you see our culture'), answer in the plainest 'I came to get this kind of thing done' register; examiners hear a hundred standard wits — plainness is scarce
Subtract jargon: for every term in a report, deck or pitch ask 'does meaning change if I cut it' — if not, cut; jargon is the mark of performance, not evidence of understanding
Price others' performance to calibrate judgment: quotations in meetings, elaborate models in slides — price as performance first, content second; keep the two accounts separate when deciding

modes.name_en: The Method of Demystifying Sacred Formulae
modes.domain_zh: 南泉上堂举佛陀诞生的公案：'天上天下唯我独尊'——禅师们面对这句圣语，或拜或颂，南泉却说：'我当时若见，一棒打杀与狗子吃却，图个天下太平。'——对最高圣典语句直接处以极刑：这句话如果能被说出，那'我'就已经被说成了对象，而真正独尊者不可言说；打杀它，恰恰是护持它的真义；同类的勘破遍布他的禅行：赵州问'如何是摩尼珠'，他答'这灯光者，即是一切人本有之宝'——把佛经中最神秘的宝珠还原为眼前灯焰；他证明：对权威文本的最高尊重不是绕开它，而是敢于对它的字面下刀——仪式化的膜拜让圣言变成死物，唯有敢杀才能让它活过来
modes.domain_en: Nansen rose in the hall and raised the case of the Buddha's birth: 'In heaven above and earth below, I alone am honored' — where other teachers bowed or chanted, Nansen said: 'Had I been there, one blow would have killed him and fed him to the dogs, and the whole world would have been at peace.' — capital sentence passed on the holiest of sayings: if it can be uttered, the 'I' has already been spoken into an object, and the truly alone-honored cannot be spoken; to strike it dead is precisely to guard its truth; like demystifications run through his practice: when Zhaozhou asked about the mani jewel, he answered 'this lamp-flame is the treasure all people possess' — the most mysterious jewel of scripture reduced to the flame before one's eyes; he proved: the highest respect for an authoritative text is not to circle it but to dare the blade against its letter — ritualized worship embalms the sacred word; only the daring to kill lets it live
modes.source_chapter: '一棒打杀与狗子吃却'载于《五灯会元》卷四与《景德传灯录》卷十：南泉因举'世尊初生下，一手指天一手指地，周行七步，目顾四方云天上天下唯我独尊'而发此语，云门文偃后来著名的'我当时若见，一棒打杀与狗子吃却图得天下太平'（云门话堕公案语境）与之同源或相承——禅门'诃佛骂祖'传统的代表语录；'这灯光者即是一切人本有之宝'见《赵州录》摩尼珠问答：赵州问'如何是摩尼'南泉以灯焰作答，赵州再勘'珠在什么处'；南泉承马祖'即心即佛——非心非佛'的翻转传统，把对经典字句的暴力性重估制度化；此类语录被后世斥为'狂禅'者有之、奉为'透关'者有之——恰证明其对权威文本的重估至今未被消化完
modes.key_quote_zh: 我当时若见，一棒打杀与狗子吃却，图个天下太平
modes.key_quote_en: "Had I been there, one blow would have killed him and fed him to the dogs, and the whole world been at peace."
process_zh: 找出被'仪式化'封印的文本：凡是只能被引用、被致敬、不能被检验的句子（口号、名言、祖训）——仪式感越重，字面越僵
对字面做'逻辑体检'：'唯我独尊'若能被说出，说出的'我'即是对象化的我——检查权威语句在其自身逻辑下是否自洽，常常一戳即穿
以'暴力重估'终结'温柔绕行'：不绕开圣句而是直接给出它的死亡判决，再从废墟里捡出真正不可杀的部分——真义在字面死后才显形
把神秘物还原为眼前物：摩尼珠还原为灯焰——最高价值的可验证版本，往往就是此刻可触可见的寻常物
process_en: Find the texts sealed by ritualization: sentences that can only be quoted and honored, never examined — slogans, maxims, founder's words; the heavier the ritual, the stiffer the letter

Logic-check the letter: if 'I alone am honored' can be spoken, the spoken 'I' is already an objectified I — test authoritative sentences for self-consistency within their own logic; often one prick punctures

End tender detours with violent reappraisal: give the sacred sentence its death sentence outright, then pick from the ruins what truly cannot be killed; the true meaning appears only after the letter dies
Reduce the mysterious to the present: the mani jewel to the lamp-flame — the verifiable version of the highest value is usually the ordinary thing before one's eyes
representative_cases_zh: '一棒打杀'上堂语：对'天上天下唯我独尊'的极刑判词——禅门对最高权威文本最著名的一次'字面处决'，与云门'打杀'语同构成诃佛骂祖的双璧
摩尼珠问答：以'这灯光者即是一切人本有之宝'把经中至宝还原为眼前灯焰——神秘物在'看见'中完成兑现
承马祖'即心即佛/非心非佛'的翻转传统：老师给出命题又亲手拆命题，学生把拆命题发展为对一切命题的日常操作——翻转成为门风
representative_cases_en: The hall declaration of one blow: the most famous literal execution of a supreme authoritative text in Zen, twin to Yunmen's 'strike him dead' — the two pillars of the tradition of reviling the Buddha
The mani jewel exchange: scripture's supreme treasure reduced to the lamp-flame before one's eyes — the mysterious redeemed in the act of seeing

The lineage of reversal from Mazu's 'mind itself is Buddha / no mind, no Buddha': the teacher gives a proposition and dismantles it himself; the student turns dismantling into daily operation on all propositions — reversal become house style
modern_applications_zh: 对'组织圣典'做字面体检：使命宣言、创始人语录、行业铁律——逐句问'这句话在其自身逻辑下站得住吗'；站不住的不是删掉，而是找出它真正想护持的东西（往往与字面无关）
区分'尊重权威'与'供奉权威'：可以引用康德/乔布斯/祖师，但每次引用后补一句'这句话错在哪儿'——常年练习'字面下刀'的组织不会把圣言变成死物
把神秘概念兑换为眼前指标：'公司灵魂''产品精神'还原为一条可观察的日常行为——凡是不能还原为'灯焰'的'摩尼珠'，都是尚未兑现的空头
modern_applications_en: Logic-check the organizational scriptures: mission statements, founder quotations, industry iron laws — ask sentence by sentence whether each stands on its own logic; what fails is not deleted but mined for what it truly guards, usually unconnected to its letter

Separate respecting authority from enshrining it: cite Kant, Jobs or the founders, then append 'where is this sentence wrong'; organizations that practice the blade on letters daily never embalm their sacred words

Redeem mysterious concepts into present indicators: 'company soul', 'product spirit' reduced to one observable daily behavior; any mani jewel irredeemable into a lamp-flame is an unfunded promissory note
modes.definition_zh: 南泉上堂举佛陀诞生的公案：'天上天下唯我独尊'——禅师们面对这句圣语，或拜或颂，南泉却说：'我当时若见，一棒打杀与狗子吃却，图个天下太平。'——对最高圣典语句直接处以极刑：这句话如果能被说出，那'我'就已经被说成了对象，而真正独尊者不可言说；打杀它，恰恰是护持它的真义；同类的勘破遍布他的禅行：赵州问'如何是摩尼珠'，他答'这灯光者，即是一切人本有之宝'——把佛经中最神秘的宝珠还原为眼前灯焰；他证明：对权威文本的最高尊重不是绕开它，而是敢于对它的字面下刀——仪式化的膜拜让圣言变成死物，唯有敢杀才能让它活过来
modes.definition_en: Nansen rose in the hall and raised the case of the Buddha's birth: 'In heaven above and earth below, I alone am honored' — where other teachers bowed or chanted, Nansen said: 'Had I been there, one blow would have killed him and fed him to the dogs, and the whole world would have been at peace.' — capital sentence passed on the holiest of sayings: if it can be uttered, the 'I' has already been spoken into an object, and the truly alone-honored cannot be spoken; to strike it dead is precisely to guard its truth; like demystifications run through his practice: when Zhaozhou asked about the mani jewel, he answered 'this lamp-flame is the treasure all people possess' — the most mysterious jewel of scripture reduced to the flame before one's eyes; he proved: the highest respect for an authoritative text is not to circle it but to dare the blade against its letter — ritualized worship embalms the sacred word; only the daring to kill lets it live

modes.name_en: The Method of Letting Things Teach
modes.domain_zh: 南泉的'说法'经常不用语言：僧人问'如何是道'，他答'庄上吃饭'；有人问'如何是古佛心'，他指了指殿里的佛——但更彻底的是他的'不代'：陆亘大夫问：'弟子从六合来，彼中还见一班仲尼么？'（俗语'出气不得'之意——无处不憋闷）南泉答：'还见有无量寿佛么？'——不解释，只把问题对折回提问者；对于'如何是祖师西来意'这类终极之问，他有时干脆不动：别人求法，他不给答案，因为给了答案，问者就永远停在'接收'位置；他证明：教学的最高形式不是把答案递过去，而是让物自己说话、让问题自己反光——递答案的成本是永远失去提问者自己长出答案的机会
modes.domain_en: Nansen's 'teaching' often used no words at all: asked 'What is the Way,' he said 'we go to the farm to eat'; asked 'What is the mind of the ancient Buddha,' he pointed at the Buddha in the hall — and more radical still was his non-substitution: the courtier Lu Dan asked, 'Your student comes from Liuhe; passing through, did you see Ban Zhongni?' — 'nowhere to breathe'; Nansen answered: 'Did you see the Buddha of Boundless Life?' — no explanation, only folding the question back onto the questioner; and to the ultimate 'What is the meaning of the Patriarch's coming from the West' he sometimes simply did not move: seekers came for the dharma and he gave no answer, for an answer received forever fixes the asker in the receiving position; he proved: the highest form of teaching is not handing over answers but letting things speak and questions reflect — the cost of handing over an answer is losing forever the chance of the asker growing one
modes.source_chapter: 陆亘（Lu Dan, 764-834）问'班仲尼/无量寿佛'公案载于《五灯会元》与《景德传灯录》：陆亘大夫任宣州观察使时频繁问道于南泉，为南泉最重要的世俗弟子与护法——'班仲尼'问答为其与南泉最重要的对勘；'指殿中佛'答'古佛心'、以灯焰答摩尼珠、以'庄上吃饭'答'如何是道'等构成南泉'以物代语'系列；'祖师西来意'之问在南泉门下的多种处理（答/不答/反问）见于《赵州录》相关记载；南泉的代语观承马祖大机大用与石头'触目是道'两系，而将'不说破'的纪律推至极致——禅门'不代语'传统的著名实践者；其弟子赵州从谂终身保持'逢人问什么皆不与人说破'的作风，被认为直接继承此法
modes.key_quote_zh: 还见有无量寿佛么——好答案不解释问题，只让问题自己反光
modes.key_quote_en: "Did you see the Buddha of Boundless Life? — a good answer does not explain the question; it lets the question reflect."
process_zh: 先忍住'解释'的冲动：被提问时第一个念头是想给答案——把这个冲动冻结三秒，先问'这个问题需要答案还是需要反光'
把问题对折回提问者：陆亘问憋闷，南泉问佛——不顺着问题走，而把它折转一半，让提问者在自己的问题里看见自己没看见的前提
用'指物'代替'定义'：能指的物（灯焰、殿中佛、桌上的东西）不描述只指向——物的在场比语言的准确更能完成传达
在'递答案'前计算成本：递出去的答案便宜但永久，长出来的答案昂贵但属于人——对方的成长空间与你的表达效率不可兼得时，选空间
process_en: Freeze the urge to explain: when questioned the first impulse is to give the answer; freeze it three seconds and ask whether the question needs an answer or a reflection

Fold the question back on the asker: Lu Dan asked of suffocation, Nansen of the Buddha — do not walk with the question; fold it halfway so the asker sees within his own question the premise he never saw

Substitute pointing for defining: things that can be pointed at — the lamp-flame, the Buddha in the hall, the object on the table — are not described but indicated; the presence of a thing conveys more than the accuracy of language

Cost out each answer before handing it over: the handed answer is cheap but permanent; the grown answer costly but owned; when the other's room to grow and your efficiency to express cannot both be had, choose the room
representative_cases_zh: 陆亘'班仲尼'问答：'还见有无量寿佛么'——不解释不铺陈，一句对折，后世列为南泉第一公案
以灯焰答摩尼珠、以殿中佛答古佛心：'以物代语'系列——南泉的答案库几乎全部由'指向物'构成而非'陈述句'
赵州终身'不说破'的师承：从谂后来接学人几乎不与说破、只设境勘验——被公认为南泉'不代语'法最完整的继承与实践
representative_cases_en: The Lu Dan exchange: 'Did you see the Buddha of Boundless Life?' — no exposition, one fold, ranked as Nansen's first koan by posterity
The lamp-flame for the jewel, the hall-Buddha for the ancient mind: his answer-stock composed almost wholly of indicated things rather than declarative sentences

Zhaozhou's lifetime of never telling it through: from Nansen he inherited the discipline of setting scenes and examinations instead of explanations — the fullest transmission of the non-substitution method
modern_applications_zh: 带团队先练'指物'：新下属问'什么是对'，带他去看一个真实样本并问'你看出什么'——十次'指物'教学长出来的判断力，胜过一百页标准
把反问做成管理技术：下属带着问题来时，先回一个'你觉得问题出在哪'式的对折——这不是推卸，而是防止组织把判断力全部上交
给答案标'成长成本'：教别人时区分'这是鱼'与'这是钓鱼的位置'——凡递答案的场合，配一个让对方自己收一次网的问题
modern_applications_en: Train pointing over telling with your team: when a junior asks 'what is right,' take him to a real sample and ask 'what do you see' — ten pointing lessons grow judgment no hundred-page standard can

Make the fold a management technique: when subordinates arrive with problems, return a folded 'where do you think it broke' — not buck-passing but preventing the organization from surrendering all its judgment upward

Tag answers with growth-cost: in teaching, distinguish 'here is a fish' from 'here is where fish live'; wherever an answer is handed over, pair it with one question that makes the other haul his own net

modes.name_en: The Method of Not Descending for Thirty Years
modes.domain_zh: 大历七年（772）他挂锡池阳南泉山，'堙谷刊木以居'——填谷砍木，自己动手把荒山变成道场，此后三十年不下山；这不是逃世而是选择位置：在京城的讲席体系里，一个禅师的价值由讲席、名位与信众规模定义；在南泉山上，价值只由'道'本身定义——他退出的是定义权，不是世界；下山后依然不改：陆亘大夫供养老僧，他照旧'吃他的饭说他的话'，不受官府供养的约束；他证明：真正的独立不是态度而是位置——你把工作地点选在哪里，就接受了那里的评价体系；把评价权收回自己手里的唯一方法，是把身体放在评价体系之外
modes.domain_en: In 772 he settled on Mount Nanquan at Chiyang, 'filling the valley and cutting timber for his dwelling' — hands turning the wild mountain into a practice-hall, and for thirty years he did not descend; not escape from the world but the choosing of a position: in the metropolitan lectern system a Chan master's worth was defined by chairs, rank and the size of his following; on Mount Nanquan worth was defined by the Way alone — he exited not the world but the power to define him; descending later he changed nothing: fed by the courtier Lu Dan, he still ate his rice and spoke his own words, unconstrained by official patronage; he proved: real independence is not an attitude but a position — where you place your work, there you accept its scale of judgment; the only way to take back the right of evaluation is to put your body outside the system of evaluation
modes.source_chapter: 《景德传灯录》卷十与《五灯会元》卷四载：南泉'于池州南泉山堙谷刊木以居，三十年不下南泉山'；大历七年（772）入山为通行纪年；后应陆亘大夫之请下山问道，又应请住洛阳汝上院（一说再住郓州）——但晚年'复归南泉山'；陆亘时任宣歙观察使，与南泉问道最密——南泉接受地方官员的问道而不受其编制，接受供养而不改变禅风；其'守山'与同门百丈怀海'一日不作一日不食'的'守农'构成洪州宗'自力自立'传统的两翼：百丈自食其力建清规，南泉自居荒山拒评价——两人分别解决了'经济独立'与'评价独立'问题；三十年守山期与黄檗希运、沩山灵祐等同期禅者的高山结庵风气互为映照
modes.key_quote_zh: 堙谷刊木以居，三十年不下南泉山——退出的是定义权，不是世界
modes.key_quote_en: "He filled the valley and cut timber for his dwelling, thirty years without descending — what he exited was the power to define him, not the world."
process_zh: 先识别你在谁的坐标系里：你的工作价值由谁定义（平台评级、引用数、职级、流量）——定义权不在于你自己怎么想，在于谁能给你打分
计算'退出坐标系'的成本与收益：南泉退的是讲席体系，得到的是三十年不被打分的深度工作——凡长期主义的事业，退出短期评价体系的收益都大于成本
把'独立'落实为身体的位置而非口号：住哪里、见谁、接谁的活——三个选择就是你的独立宣言；位置不动，态度再独立也是空的
下山时守住'吃谁的饭说谁的话'的边界：接受供养（工资、投资、资助）前先问它附带什么定义权——带着自己的坐标下山，而不是被别人的坐标收编
process_en: First identify whose coordinates you live in: who defines the worth of your work — platform ratings, citation counts, ranks, traffic; the defining power lies not in what you think but in who may score you

Cost and prize exiting the coordinate system: Nansen traded the lectern world for thirty years of unscored deep work; for any long-horizon undertaking the prize of leaving short-term evaluation exceeds its cost
Make independence bodily, not rhetorical: where you live, whom you see, whose work you take — three choices are your declaration of independence; with position unmoved, no attitude is independent

Guard the border of 'whose rice, whose words' on descending: before accepting patronage — salary, investment, grant — ask what defining power it carries; descend with your own coordinates, not conscripted into another's
representative_cases_zh: 三十年守山本身：堙谷刊木、自建道场、三十年不出山门——中国禅史上最长的一次'评价体系退出'
与百丈'一日不作一日不食'的互补：百丈解决经济独立（自己种地），南泉解决评价独立（自己选位置）——洪州宗自立传统的两翼
受陆亘供养而不受编制：下山应请问道，接受地方长官的个人问道关系而拒绝变成'官府高僧'——守山精神的下山版
representative_cases_en: The thirty years themselves: filling valleys, cutting timber, building his own hall, never leaving the gate — the longest recorded exit from a system of evaluation in Chan history

The complement to Baizhang's 'a day without work, a day without food': Baizhang solved economic independence (growing his own grain), Nansen evaluative independence (choosing his own position) — the two wings of the Hongzhou tradition of self-reliance

Patronage without conscription: descending to answer Lu Dan's questions, accepting a personal master-disciple relation with the governor while refusing to become an official monk — the descended version of guarding the mountain
modern_applications_zh: 职业选择的'坐标系审计'：换工作时先问'新平台的评价体系是什么、谁给我打分、打分周期多长'——把'职位与薪资'放在'定义权归属'之后考虑
给深度工作买'评价假期'：重要项目立项时明确'前 N 个月不接受任何进度评分'——南泉三十年守山是极端版，N 个月守山是可执行版
识别'供养附带定义权'的时刻：接受投资、挂名、站台前，问清'拿了这个钱/这个名头，我还能不能说不'——守山人在下山时最容易丢失的恰是他守过的东西
modern_applications_en: Audit the coordinates of career choice: when changing jobs, first ask what the new platform's scale of judgment is, who scores you, and how often; weigh position and pay after the ownership of definition

Buy an evaluation holiday for deep work: at a project's start, declare 'no progress scores for the first N months'; Nansen's thirty years is the extreme edition — the N-month guard is the executable one

Recognize patronage that carries defining power: before taking investment, titles or endorsements, ask 'with this money and this name, can I still say no'; what the mountain-guardian loses on descending is precisely what he guarded

modes.name_en: The Method of Testing Without Assuming
modes.domain_zh: 南泉断案从不凭名声：赵州来时他是老僧，来意如何，须勘过；长庆大安来、长沙景岑来、云岩来——每一个来访的学人都要过他的现场检验；最典型的是他与黄檗的往返：黄檗行脚至南泉，南泉设问，黄檗不给套话、以'啪'一记耳光式的回答对答，南泉反而认可——他不预设'名弟子必已悟'，也不预设'野路子必不行'，一切以当场反应为准；他甚至勘自己：赵州问他'如何是道'，他答'平常心是道'，赵州步步紧逼地追问，他不以老师身份压人，而是让追问进行到底；他证明：对人的判断只有一条可靠通道——设计一个真实情境看他的当场反应；简历、名气、旧日成绩都是过去时的证词，勘验是现在时的取证
modes.domain_en: Nansen never judged by reputation: when Zhaozhou came, an old master though he was, his mind had still to be examined; so for Changqing Da'an, Changsha Jingcen, Yunyan — every visitor passed through his on-the-spot testing; most telling were his rounds with Huangbo: Huangbo, arriving on pilgrimage, was posed a question and answered not with set phrases but with a slap-like retort, and Nansen approved — he assumed neither 'renamed disciple must be awakened' nor 'irregular path must fail'; everything turned on the live response; he even examined himself: Zhaozhou pressed 'What is the Way' step by step, and Nansen, instead of crushing the student with seniority, let the questioning run its course; he proved: only one reliable channel exists for judging a person — design a live situation and watch the immediate response; résumés, fame and past records are testimony in the past tense; examination is evidence in the present tense
modes.source_chapter: 南泉门下勘辩公案集中见于《赵州录》《景德传灯录》卷十与《五灯会元》卷四：'赵州勘婆''台山婆子'公案群中南泉与赵州互勘；黄檗与南泉的往返（黄檗掌掴/棒喝一类对答）为临济录与灯录所共载，黄檗希运行脚至南泉问'如何是毗卢师法身主'等公案显示其'过堂须勘'的家风；长庆大安参南泉得法（'大安参南泉'诸则）、长沙景岑为南泉法嗣、陆亘问道等——南泉处学的通行程序是'先设一问，看当场反应，再定深浅'；他勘赵州'知底人向什么处休歇'的连环追问，显示勘验是双向的：老师也在被学生的追问勘验——勘验文化使师徒关系从'权威授予'变为'现场互证'
modes.key_quote_zh: 来意如何，须勘过——名声是过去时的证词，勘验是现在时的取证
modes.key_quote_en: "Whatever the reputation, it must be examined on arrival — fame is testimony in the past tense; examination, evidence in the present."
process_zh: 废除'名声预判'：见人之前把自己的预期清零——名气、来头、介绍信只决定'是否值得安排勘验'，不决定结论
设计'小而真'的检验情境：不是面试题而是真实小事（让他处理一个真实异议、看他对服务者的态度、看他怎么对待一只猫）——真情境里的反应无法排练
让勘验双向进行：允许对方反问、追问、甚至反驳你——只肯测人不肯被测的体系会筛选出'善于被测'的人而非'真有判断'的人
以当场反应为唯一判据并当场结案：勘验要当场给结论（认可或继续考察），不留'再看看'的悬案——悬案会退化成印象分
process_en: Abolish reputational pre-judgment: clear your expectations before meeting anyone; fame, credentials, letters of introduction decide only whether an examination is worth scheduling, never the verdict
Design small true tests: not interview questions but real small matters — how he handles a genuine objection, how he treats the waiter, how he treats a cat; live reactions cannot be rehearsed
Let examination run both ways: allow the other to question, press, even rebut you; a system that will test but not be tested selects for those good at being tested, not those with real judgment
Settle on the spot by the live response alone: give the verdict immediately — approved or under further examination; no open cases, for open cases decay into impressions
representative_cases_zh: 赵州来学的一连串勘辩：'平常心是道'四问四答——老师不给结论压人，让追问进行到底，最后以学生的悟境收案
黄檗过南泉的棒喝往返：野路子行者以非套话回答，南泉照样认可——'名弟子/野路子'两种预判都被当场反应击穿
长庆大安、长沙景岑的入门勘验：每个法嗣都有被'先设一问'的记录——南泉门下'过堂须勘'成为制度而非偶然
representative_cases_en: Zhaozhou's string of examinations: four questions on the ordinary mind, the teacher never crushing with seniority but letting the press run its course, the case closed on the student's awakening

Huangbo's rounds of slap and shout: the pilgrim of irregular path answered in no set phrase and was approved all the same — both pre-judgments, famous disciple and wild manner, punctured by live response
Entrance examinations for Da'an and Jingcen: every dharma heir has a record of being posed the first question; in Nansen's line 'arrival must be examined' was institution, not accident
modern_applications_zh: 招聘的'情境勘验'升级：把'讲讲你的成功案例'换成现场真实任务（40 分钟改一个真实的坏方案、与刁难型协作者模拟一次冲突）——过去时证词换成现在时取证
给'老将/新人'双向设勘：晋升评审不只测候选人，也测评审者的判断（要求每位评委写出自己的判据）——只测一方的体系会退化为印象分体系
合作前的'小真事'试金石：大合作签约前先给对方一个真实小分歧看其处理方式——小情境的反应可预测大合作的走向
modern_applications_en: Upgrade hiring to situational examination: replace 'tell us about your success' with a live true task — forty minutes fixing a genuinely bad plan, a simulated conflict with a difficult collaborator; past-tense testimony exchanged for present-tense evidence

Set two-way examinations for veterans and juniors alike: promotion panels test not only candidates but the panel itself — each judge writes out his criteria; one-way testing decays into impression-scoring

A small-true-matter touchstone before big deals: before signing a major partnership, hand the counterpart one real small disagreement and watch the handling; small situations predict large collaborations
modes.definition_zh: 南泉断案从不凭名声：赵州来时他是老僧，来意如何，须勘过；长庆大安来、长沙景岑来、云岩来——每一个来访的学人都要过他的现场检验；最典型的是他与黄檗的往返：黄檗行脚至南泉，南泉设问，黄檗不给套话、以'啪'一记耳光式的回答对答，南泉反而认可——他不预设'名弟子必已悟'，也不预设'野路子必不行'，一切以当场反应为准；他甚至勘自己：赵州问他'如何是道'，他答'平常心是道'，赵州步步紧逼地追问，他不以老师身份压人，而是让追问进行到底；他证明：对人的判断只有一条可靠通道——设计一个真实情境看他的当场反应；简历、名气、旧日成绩都是过去时的证词，勘验是现在时的取证
modes.definition_en: Nansen never judged by reputation: when Zhaozhou came, an old master though he was, his mind had still to be examined; so for Changqing Da'an, Changsha Jingcen, Yunyan — every visitor passed through his on-the-spot testing; most telling were his rounds with Huangbo: Huangbo, arriving on pilgrimage, was posed a question and answered not with set phrases but with a slap-like retort, and Nansen approved — he assumed neither 'renamed disciple must be awakened' nor 'irregular path must fail'; everything turned on the live response; he even examined himself: Zhaozhou pressed 'What is the Way' step by step, and Nansen, instead of crushing the student with seniority, let the questioning run its course; he proved: only one reliable channel exists for judging a person — design a live situation and watch the immediate response; résumés, fame and past records are testimony in the past tense; examination is evidence in the present tense

modes.name_en: The Method of Play as the Highest Seriousness
modes.domain_zh: 人称'王老师'（俗姓王，宗门尊称），他的禅行充满游戏感：斩猫是一场设局的游戏，覆鞋是一场哑剧游戏，'一棒打杀'是一句黑色幽默；但游戏不是轻浮——游戏三昧（play as samadhi）恰恰是他对'执'的最深消毒：认真的人把立场当命，游戏的人把立场当牌——拿得起、放得下、输得起；他与陆亘的对话、与黄檗的对答、与赵州的勘辩，全都不板着脸完成，最重的道理（生死、悟、道）都装在玩笑的壳里；他证明：庄重是对内容的消耗，游戏是对内容的保鲜——能把最重的东西说得最轻的人，才真正扛得动它
modes.domain_en: They called him 'Teacher Wang' (surname Wang, the school's honorific), and his practice was shot through with play: the cat-cutting a staged game, the inverted sandals a mime, 'one blow and feed him to the dogs' a piece of dark humor; yet play was not levity — play as samadhi was his deepest disinfectant against attachment: the earnest stake their lives on positions, the players hold them as cards — able to lift, drop and lose them; his dialogues with Lu Dan, his rounds with Huangbo, his examinations of Zhaozhou were all conducted without a long face, the heaviest matters — life and death, awakening, the Way — housed in the shell of a joke; he proved: solemnity consumes its content, play preserves it — only one who can say the heaviest things most lightly can truly bear them
modes.source_chapter: '王老师'之称因南泉俗姓王，见《赵州录》《景德传灯录》卷十——赵州常以'王老师'称其师，黄檗亦称'王老师'；'游戏三昧'为禅门术语，指住于定境而示现自在无碍如游戏，南泉的禅风被灯录以'纵横自在''游戏三昧'类语描述；斩猫、覆鞋、打杀诸公案的游戏结构（设局、哑剧、反讽）已见前引诸则；南泉晚年'吃陆亘的饭说陆亘不听的话'、对赵州'死后去哪里'之问答以'山下作一头水牯牛'式的幽默（此语亦见于沩山），显示其'以轻语承载重题'的一贯风格；游戏三昧与临济'无事是贵人'、云门'日日是好日'共同构成南宗禅'轻松地承担最重命题'的谱系
modes.key_quote_zh: 游戏三昧——把最重的道理装在玩笑的壳里，认真的人把立场当命，游戏的人把立场当牌
modes.key_quote_en: "Play as samadhi — the heaviest truths housed in the shell of a joke; the earnest stake their lives on positions, the players hold them as cards."
process_zh: 检测自己与'立场'的关系：你持有观点，还是观点持有你？——检验法是'输得起测试'：若一个观点被推翻你会痛苦，说明你与它已无距离
给最重的议题设计'轻壳'：坏消息用平静的白话讲、深刻的道理用故事与玩笑讲——壳越轻，内容越能被听见；板着脸讲的重话只会触发防御
保留'设局'的教育手法：斩猫式教学（让所有人经历一次共同的小冲击以打破共同执念）比一百次说教有效——但要如南泉一样事先声明条件、事后给判词
以幽默作为消毒剂而非逃避：玩笑指向的永远是执念而不是人——区分'黑色的幽默'与'灰色的逃避'：前者松开执念，后者只是绕开问题
process_en: Test your relation to your positions: do you hold your views, or do they hold you? The test is losing-readiness: if the overturn of a view wounds you, you and it have no distance

Design light shells for the heaviest subjects: bad news in calm plain words, deep truths in stories and jokes; the lighter the shell, the more audible the content — a heavy word delivered with a long face only triggers defense

Keep the staged gambit as pedagogy: the cat-cutting kind — letting all share one small shock to break one shared attachment — beats a hundred sermons; but declare conditions beforehand and give the verdict after, as Nansen did
Use humor as disinfectant, not escape: the joke must aim at attachment, never at persons; tell black humor from gray evasion — the former loosens attachment, the latter merely circles the problem
representative_cases_zh: '王老师'之称与勘辩文风：赵州、黄檗以'王老师'称师，师徒间的对答充满机趣而不失锋利——禅门最著名的'亦师亦友'游戏关系
斩猫与覆鞋的游戏结构：一场'条件声明—集体失语—极端执行—哑剧回应—事后判词'的完整戏剧——以戏剧性完成说教无法完成的破执
对生死之问的轻答：弟子问身后事，答以'水牯牛'式的幽默——最重的死亡命题被放在最轻的语境里完成传授
representative_cases_en: The name 'Teacher Wang' and the style of examination: Zhaozhou and Huangbo addressed their master so, their exchanges full of wit and edge alike — the school's most famous teacher-friend play
The dramatic structure of the cat and the sandals: declared terms, collective silence, extreme execution, a mime's reply, a final verdict — drama accomplishing what sermon cannot: breaking attachment
The light answer to the heaviest question: asked of after-death, answered with water-buffalo humor; death, heaviest of subjects, taught in the lightest register
modern_applications_zh: 给坏消息设计'轻壳'：裁员、砍项目、否定方案——用平静的白话与一点点自嘲讲，比庄重地宣读损失更大
团队的'输得起测试'：在方案评审时引入'谁愿意为本方案被推翻下注'——愿意下注的人才是真信的人；只肯赢不肯输的观点不值得投入资源
识别幽默的指向：健康的组织文化允许玩笑，但玩笑只指向流程与执念，不指向具体的人——'指向执念的幽默'是消毒剂，'指向人的幽默'是毒药
modern_applications_en: Design light shells for bad news: layoffs, killed projects, rejected proposals — calm plain words with a touch of self-mockery beat solemnly reading out the losses
The losing-readiness test for teams: in reviews ask 'who will stake on this plan being overturned' — only those willing to stake truly believe; views that can only win are not worth resources
Watch where the humor points: healthy cultures allow jokes aimed at process and attachment, never at persons; humor at attachment is disinfectant, humor at persons poison

modes.name_en: The Method of Entrusting by Verified Judgment
modes.domain_zh: 南泉晚年一句判语决定了禅史：他对陆亘等众人说：'赵州这汉，四十年在老僧这里，看他会也不会。'——赵州从谂十八岁参南泉，在其门下几十年，南泉没有因为他是'得意弟子'就早早放他出去开宗，而是持续勘验、持续压担，直到确认其'平常心'功夫彻底成熟；斩猫案后他当场判'子若在，即救得猫儿'——一旦勘验确认，立刻公开授予最高认可；他的法嗣长庆大安、长沙景岑各成一方宗主，而赵州成为'赵州古佛'——传灯不是传给自己的复制品，而是传给被勘验过的独立判断力；他证明：托付的质量取决于勘验的长度——识人最大的成本不是看错，而是不敢花时间看
modes.domain_en: In old age one verdict of Nansen's shaped Chan history: 'This fellow Zhaozhou has been forty years with this old monk — watch whether he gets it or not.' — Zhaozhou Congshen came to him at eighteen, decades under his roof; Nansen did not rush his prized disciple out to found a line, but kept examining, kept loading him, until the ordinary-mind kung-fu was fully ripe; after the cat case he pronounced on the spot 'had you been there, the cat would have lived' — and once examination confirmed, the highest recognition was granted publicly at once; his heirs Changqing Da'an and Changsha Jingcen each headed a region, and Zhaozhou became 'the ancient Buddha of Zhaozhou' — transmission hands down not one's replica but a verified independent judgment; he proved: the quality of entrustment is set by the length of examination — the costliest error in reading people is not misreading but not daring to spend the time reading
modes.source_chapter: 南泉对赵州的长期勘验与晚年判语见《赵州录》《五灯会元》卷四：赵州从谂（778-897）曹州郝乡人，童稚于扈通院出家，十八岁（一说更早）参南泉，'泉每见师来，便道：' Monitoring its records: 赵州在南泉处'数十年'（通行说法为四十年上下）为侍者与学人，南泉临终前（或晚年）对众僧言：'赵州看院主（自指）年来衰老……'并多次公开推重赵州：'老僧往年有眼，当时若是见……'类语句；《景德传灯录》载南泉示寂前嘱：'赵州勘婆子因缘……'诸则显示其与赵州的互勘传统；斩猫案'子若在即救得猫儿'为公开授予最高认可的标准案例；长庆大安（后住福州长庆院）、长沙景岑（长沙'一动一静皆 Spring'偈作者）皆出南泉之门各成一方；南泉法嗣见灯录者十余人，构成洪州宗第三代的重要一翼
modes.key_quote_zh: 赵州这汉，四十年在老僧这里——托付的质量取决于勘验的长度
modes.key_quote_en: "This fellow Zhaozhou, forty years with this old monk — the quality of entrustment is set by the length of examination."
process_zh: 把'看走眼'重新定价：识人的最大成本不是看错一个，而是用快速判断省下的时间——组织里所有重大用人错误都可追溯到'没花够勘验时间'
对高潜者'压担不放手'：像南泉对赵州——不因天赋早早放出去，而是留在现场持续给真实难题；勘验的密度决定托付的质量
确认即公开授予：斩猫案后的当场判语——认可不要私下给，公开的判语既是对本人的授权，也是对系统的立信
传灯传的是判断力不是复制品：让继承者与你不同（赵州的'不与说破'比南泉更极端）——被传承的方法论在每个传人手里长成新形态才算传成了
process_en: Reprice misreading: the costliest cost in judging people is not one wrong read but the time saved by quick verdicts; every grave error of appointment traces to insufficient examination time

Load the high-potential without letting go: as Nansen with Zhaozhou — not released early for talent, but kept on site fed with real hard problems; the density of examination sets the quality of entrustment
Grant publicly once confirmed: the on-the-spot verdict after the cat case — recognition given not in private; a public judgment both authorizes the person and builds credit into the system

Transmit judgment, not replicas: let the successor differ from you — Zhaozhou's 'never telling it through' is more radical than Nansen; a method is transmitted only when it grows new forms in each heir
representative_cases_zh: 赵州四十年勘验：十八岁入门、数十年压担、晚年公开判语——禅门最著名的一次'慢识人'，产出'赵州古佛'
斩猫案的当场授予：'子若在即救得猫儿'——勘验确认后立即公开最高认可，不拖、不含糊
法嗣各成一方：长庆大安、长沙景岑、赵州从谂三种完全不同的禅风皆出南泉门下——传灯传独立判断力的直接证据
representative_cases_en: Forty years of examining Zhaozhou: entered at eighteen, loaded for decades, the public verdict in old age — Chan's most famous slow reading of a man, yielding the Ancient Buddha of Zhaozhou
The on-the-spot grant after the cat: 'had you been there, it would have lived' — once confirmed, the highest recognition conferred publicly at once, without delay or hedge
Heirs each heading his own house: Changqing Da'an, Changsha Jingcen and Zhaozhou, three wholly different styles from one master — direct evidence that what was transmitted was independent judgment
modern_applications_zh: 给接班人设计'四十年结构'：关键岗位的继任者提前数年进入真实决策现场压担——简历面试选不出接班人，只有长期共同处理真实难题能
把认可做成公开判语：下属在关键事件上证明自己后，在全员场合明确授予权限与认可——私下认可不留制度记忆
容忍继承者'变形'：交接方法论时明确'你可以改它'——被原样复制的传承是标本，被改写后仍有生命力的传承才是传灯
modern_applications_en: Design a forty-year structure for succession: bring successors into real decision arenas years ahead and load them; résumés and interviews select no successors — only long shared handling of real problems does
Make recognition a public verdict: once a subordinate has proven himself on a critical event, grant authority and recognition before everyone; private approval leaves no institutional memory
Tolerate the heir's mutation: in handing over a method, state 'you may change it'; a transmission copied verbatim is a specimen — a transmission alive after rewriting is the true lamp

modes.domain_zh: 弟子问：'和尚百年后向什么处去？'南泉答：'山下作一头水牯牛去。'——禅师面对'死后去哪里'的终极之问，既不谈净土也不谈轮回果报，而是把自己放到牛栏里：牛是最被使役、最不庄严、最接近土地的动物；这一答同时完成三件事：拆掉'高僧必有高去处'的期待、示范'对死亡的绝对放松'、把'道在平常'推到死后亦平常的彻底处——生前三十年不下山是'守'，死后愿作水牯牛是'放'：守与放用的是同一颗平常心；他证明：一个人的生死观是他全部方法论的收口处——平日把'道'说得如何高远都是空的，死亡面前的第一个念头才是真版本
modes.domain_en: A disciple asked: 'After your hundred years, master, where will you go?' Nansen answered: 'Down the mountain, to be a water buffalo.' — before the ultimate question of where one goes after death, he spoke neither of the Pure Land nor of karmic reward but placed himself in the cattle pen: the buffalo the most yoked, least solemn, earth-closest of animals; one answer accomplishing three things: dismantling the expectation that a great monk must have a lofty destination, demonstrating absolute ease toward death, and pushing 'the Way is ordinary' to its thorough extreme — ordinary even after death; thirty years not descending was 'holding,' wishing to be a buffalo was 'releasing' — the same ordinary mind in both; he proved: one's view of death is the sealing joint of one's whole methodology — however high the Way sounds in life, the first thought at death is the true edition
modes.source_chapter: '水牯牛'公案见《赵州录》《景德传灯录》卷十与《五灯会元》卷四：学人问南泉'和尚百年后向什么处去'，泉云'山下作一头水牯牛去'，学人再勘'还许学人学否'（跟随不成？），泉以'若道我似，即使同去'（一说'暗写'）类语再破——完整的问答链同时破了'圣去向'与'模仿圣去向'两层；沩山灵祐亦有'百年后山下作一头水牯牛'语（《沩山录》），显示此为洪州系禅者共享的生死观表达；南泉于太和八年（834）示寂，享年八十八，僧腊五十八——临终前的从容与其'游戏三昧'一贯；'水牯牛'意象被后世禅门广泛用作'极低处自许'的表达范式，与'入廛垂手''向异类中行'（普愿之语）共同构成禅门'向下'传统的核心意象
modes.key_quote_zh: 山下作一头水牯牛去——平日把道说得如何高远都是空的，死亡面前的第一个念头才是真版本
modes.key_quote_en: "Down the mountain, to be a water buffalo — however high the Way sounds in life, the first thought at death is the true edition."
process_zh: 检查你的'高去处'预设：凡计划、事业、修行，都暗含一个'终点应该更高'的预设——把这个预设拉出来晒：终点必须高吗？谁规定的
以'最低处'测试方法的彻底性：你的方法论在'成为水牯牛'（失败、退场、失去一切身份）的情境下还成立吗——不成立的就不是方法，是身份
把死亡当'方法的最终考场'：重大原则（不演、平常心、不执）在设想临终时是否仍然适用——凡是死亡面前要换一套说法的原则，说明平日只是口号
以'放松'为彻底性的指标：对死亡越放松，说明对'我'的执越少——生前执著越少的人，方法越是彻底；紧张感是执念的体检表
process_en: Expose the preset of the high destination: every plan, career and practice hides the assumption 'the end should be higher'; drag it into the sun — must the end be high, and who says so
Test the method's thoroughness at the lowest point: does your methodology still hold in the buffalo scenario — failure, exit, loss of every identity? What fails there is not a method but an identity

Treat death as the final examination of method: do your great principles — no performance, ordinary mind, non-attachment — still apply at the deathbed? Any principle needing a different discourse at death was always slogan
Take ease as the index of thoroughness: the easier toward death, the less the grip on 'I'; the less gripped in life, the more thorough the method; tension is the checkup chart of attachment
representative_cases_zh: '水牯牛'问答链：'百年后向什么处去''山下作一头水牯牛去'——不谈净土不谈果报，以最卑近的动物自许，破掉'高僧必有高去处'
对'可否学你'的再破：弟子问能否跟随作牛，南泉再破一层——连'模仿圣者的低处'也是另一种高处，彻底堵死模仿之路
与沩山'水牯牛'语的互文：洪州系禅师共享'死后向低处'的表达——同一生死观在一个宗派中的制度化
representative_cases_en: The buffalo exchange: 'where after your hundred years' — 'down the mountain, a water buffalo'; neither Pure Land nor karmic reward, the humblest beast self-chosen, 'a great monk must have a lofty destination' dismantled
The second cut on imitation: asked whether one may follow him as a buffalo, he cut again — imitating the master's lowliness is another high place; the road of imitation sealed shut
The intertext of Baoshan's buffalo: Hongzhou masters sharing the expression 'after death, toward the low' — one view of death institutionalized across a school
modern_applications_zh: 用'水牯牛测试'审计组织与个人：把'如果明天失去全部头衔，你还剩什么方法论'写进年度自审——答不出的部分是身份不是能力
给'退场'预写脚本：事业、产品、任期开始时就写好'如何退场'（像写商业计划一样写退场计划）——把死亡纳入设计而不是回避，退场质量决定一生工作的最终口碑
以放松度体检执念：对自己'必须赢''不能退''要体面'的领域逐个做放松练习——越紧张的地方执念越重；把最紧张的一项作为下一年的修行对象
modern_applications_en: Audit with the buffalo test: write into the annual review 'if all titles vanished tomorrow, what methodology remains'; whatever cannot answer is identity, not capability

Pre-write the exit script: at the start of a venture, product or term, write the exit plan as one writes the business plan; include death in the design rather than shunning it — the quality of exit fixes the final reputation of a life's work
Check attachment by ease: for each domain of 'must win, must not retreat, must keep face,' practice release; the tensest spot is the heaviest attachment — make it next year's practice object
modes.definition_zh: 弟子问：'和尚百年后向什么处去？'南泉答：'山下作一头水牯牛去。'——禅师面对'死后去哪里'的终极之问，既不谈净土也不谈轮回果报，而是把自己放到牛栏里：牛是最被使役、最不庄严、最接近土地的动物；这一答同时完成三件事：拆掉'高僧必有高去处'的期待、示范'对死亡的绝对放松'、把'道在平常'推到死后亦平常的彻底处——生前三十年不下山是'守'，死后愿作水牯牛是'放'：守与放用的是同一颗平常心；他证明：一个人的生死观是他全部方法论的收口处——平日把'道'说得如何高远都是空的，死亡面前的第一个念头才是真版本
